verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments platform with reporting components and payment/merchant data, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents AI-generated insights or suggestions. Reporting components, real-time underwriting verifications and the llms.txt docs file are adjacent features, not AI insights drawn from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
